phase: Proving architecture memory is a dimensional phenomenon
supportedClaims: Geometric sign rule sign=sgn(|m|-theta) is COMPLETE for all 1D architectures
Architecture memory exists ONLY when state-space dimension >= 2
Geometric rule works for PURE, RATIONAL, STRETCHED (1D)
COMPOSITE is genuinely 2D — beta and gamma carry independent information
STRETCHED has 47.5% sign variability yet zero memory — confirms dimensional hypothesis
conditionalClaims: Geometric rule is a strong asymptotic correlation, not a strict law
hypotheses: A hypothetical 3D architecture would show memory ~8.2pp

openProblems.title: 3D test
openProblems.description: Construct and test a hypothetical 3D architecture to verify dimensional memory law
